source: Chapter 714: The Fractured Tamara Family
target: Capitulum 714: Familia Tamara Confracta

source: Jebus eagerly observed Franca and Jenna after mentioning 0-05, hoping to witness expressions of shock and terror on their faces.
target: Jebus Francam et Jennam aviditer observavit postquam 0-05 commemoravit, sperans videre vultus eorum stupefactos et territos.

source: Considering the immense power demonstrated by this Beyonder team, they surely grasped the gravity of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact!
target: Considerata ingenti potentia quam hic manipulus Beyonder ostendit, certe intellexerunt gravitatem Artefacti Sigillati Gradus 0.

source: It was a horrifying object capable of obliterating not just Trier, but potentially the whole world!
target: Erat obiectum horrendum, quod non solum Trier, sed etiam totum orbem delere poterat.

source: The higher the serial number of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, the more dangerous it would be.
target: Quanto altior numerus serialis Artefacti Sigillati Gradus 0, tanto periculosior esset.

source: And now, they were talking about 0-05!
target: Et nunc, de 0-05 loquebantur!

source: While Franca and Jenna were intrigued and surprised, their reaction didn’t match Jebus’s expectations.
target: Dum Franca et Jenna miratae atque obstupuerunt, eorum reactio non conveniebat cum exspectationibus Jebusi.

source: Instead of responding to Jebus, they turned their attention to Lumian.
target: Pro responso ad Jebum, illi animos ad Luminum converterunt.

source: Despite not having seen or dared to read the details, they had learned from Lumian that Ludwig, the monstrous child, had “stolen” Sealed Artifact information from the Church of Knowledge and given it to Lumian as payment for a deal.
target: Quamquam singula nec vidissent nec ausi essent legere, ex Luminum didicerunt Ludovicum, puer monstrum, notitias de Artefacto Sigillato ab Ecclesia Scientiae “subripuisse” atque illas Lumiano pro solutione tradidisse.

source: The information pertained to 0-01!
target: Notitia ad 0-01 attinebat!

source: 0-05? Lumian raised an eyebrow.
target: “0-05?” Luminum unam supercilium elevavit.

source: To his knowledge, Sealed Artifacts probably didn’t have serial numbers in ancient times.
target: Secundum scientiam eius, artefacta sigillata fortasse in temporibus antiquis numeros seriales non habebant.

source: Even if they did, they were individual actions of different Churches.
target: Etiam si habuerunt, haec erant casus singulares diversarum Ecclesiarum.

source: It wasn’t until the end of the Fourth Epoch or the beginning of the Fifth Epoch that the seven ruling Churches established the current Sealed Artifact classification rules and numbered the ones under their control.
target: Non ante finem Quartae Epochae aut initium Quintae Epochae septem Ecclesiae regantes regulas classificationis Artefacti Sigillati currentis constituerunt et ea, quae sub eorum potestate erant, numeraverunt.

source: Among them, due to the immense danger posed by Grade 0 and Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, the orthodox Churches had agreed to share general information with each other and unify their serial numbers without duplicates.
target: Inter illas, propter ingentem periculum ab Artefactis Sigillatis Gradus 0 et Gradus 1, Ecclesiae orthodoxae concesserunt ut informationes generales inter se communiquerent atque numeros seriales sine duplicatis unificarent.

source: In other words, it was impossible for both the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the Evernight Goddess Church to possess a 0-05 Sealed Artifact.
target: Id est, impossibile erat ut et Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flammae et Ecclesia Deae Perpetuae Noctis artefactum sigillatam 0-05 haberent.

source: In the entire world, only the Magic Wishing Lamp could be called 0-05!
target: In toto orbe, sola Lampada Magica Votiva appellari poterat 0-05!

source: When the seven Churches first numbered their Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, they undoubtedly ranked them according to the level of danger, time of appearance, and intrinsic uniqueness.
target: Cum septem Ecclesiae primum Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0 numeraverunt, sine dubio ea ordinaverunt secundum gradum periculi, tempus apparentiae, et propriam unicitatem.

source: Subsequent acquisitions would be named in the order they were sealed.
target: Acquisita subsequentia nominabantur ordine quo sigillata erant.

source: This way, there was a high likelihood that the dozens of Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts at the top of the list would adhere to posing greater danger and having greater uniqueness the lower the serial number.
target: Hoc modo, alta probabilitas erat ut plura Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0 in summa indice, quo numerus serialis minor esset, maiora pericula et singularitatem exhiberent.

source: For 0-05 to be ranked fifth among the countless Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts spoke volumes about its terrifying power and significance!
target: Quod 0-05 quinta ordo esset inter innumerabilia Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0, multa de eius terribili potentia atque significatione narrabat!

source: Of course, based on these rules, the Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts with the lowest serial numbers might not necessarily be weaker than those with higher serial numbers.
target: Certe, secundum has regulas, artefacta sigillata Gradus 0 cum numeris serialibus minimis non necessario minoris potentiae erant quam ea cum numeris serialibus altioribus.

source: Lumian looked at Jebus and said in a relatively calm tone, “0-05? A terrifying item ranked fifth among all Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts?”
target: Lumian Jebum aspexit et, voce relative tranquilla, dixit: “0-05? Res terribilis, quinta ordinata inter omnia Artefacta Sigillata Gradus 0?”

source: “Indeed,” Jebus replied, his desire to show off finally satisfied.
target: “Certe,” respondit Jebus, desiderio ostentationis demum satisfacto.

source: Lumian inquired curiously, “Does its name, Magic Wishing Lamp, imply that you can make wishes with it?”
target: Lumian curiose interrogavit: “Num nomen eius, Lampada Magica Votiva, significat te posse vota facere?”

source: At that moment, Lumian’s heart swelled with anticipation that surpassed his outward expression.
target: Illo momento, cor Lumiani exspectatione effusum est, quae eius externam expressionem superabat.

source: Jebus nodded solemnly.
target: Jebus solemniter annuit.

source: “Yes, it can grant the holder any ten wishes.”
target: “Ita, possessori quascumque decem vota concedere potest.”

source: Before Lumian could probe further, Jebus added, “However, as far as I know, the fulfillment of those wishes often takes a distorted form or comes with horrifying consequences.
target: Priusquam Lumian ulterius indagare potuit, Jebus addidit: “Attamen, quantum mihi nota est, effectio istorum votorum saepe formam distortam capit aut secum consequitur horribilibus eventibus.

source: Moreover, none of those who once possessed the divine lamp met a good end.
target: Praeterea, nemo qui olim lampadam divinam habebat, bene finem accepit.

source: Perhaps Roselle Gustav met his demise because of this.
target: Fortasse Roselle Gustav propter hoc mortem subiit.

source: Lumian fell silent upon hearing this revelation.
target: Lumian, hanc revelationem audita, tacuit.

source: Franca glanced at Lumian and asked, “Did 0-05 once belong to Emperor Roselle?”
target: Franca ad Luminum respexit et rogavit: “Num 0-05 olim Imperatori Roselle pertinebat?”

source: Jebus responded without hesitation, “Yes.”
target: Jebus sine dubitatione respondit: “Ita.”

source: Franca inquired with interest, “What about now? Do you have any leads on 0-05’s whereabouts?”
target: Franca, studio affecta, interrogavit: “Quid de nunc? Habesne ullam indiciam de loco ubi 0-05 sit?”

source: Jebus was eager to share what he knew.
target: Jebus cupidus erat ea, quae noverat, communicare.

source: “Yes, it should be with the leader of the secret organization, Element Dawn.
target: “Ita, id debet esse cum duce organisationis secretæ, Element Dawn.

source: “That leader is believed to be Roselle’s eldest daughter, Bernadette.”
target: Iste dux creditur esse filia primogenita Roselle, Bernadetta.

source: “Wow!” Franca exclaimed in admiration and relief, as if the child of an old friend was thriving after the latter’s passing.
target: “O mirum!” exclamavit Franca cum admiratione et solacio, quasi filia antiqui amici post obitum eius floreret.

source: Although she and Lumian had learned after the sea prayer ritual that Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter, Bernadette, was alive and had invented fairytale magic, closely linked to the Tarot Club’s Major Arcana card, The Hermit, they were unaware of her precise circumstances.
target: Quamquam illa et Lumian post ritum maritimum orationis didicerunt filiam primogenitam Imperatoris Roselle, Bernadettam, viventem esse et magiam ex fabulis invenerat, arcte coniunctam cum charta Maior Arcana Taroti, “Eremita”, de condicionibus eius exactis nescire.

source: Now, she was pleasantly surprised to discover that Bernadette had become the leader of a secret organization.
target: Nunc laeta est, cum invenit Bernadettam ducem organisationis secretæ factam esse.

source: Franca had long been familiar with Element Dawn.
target: Franca diu Element Dawn cognita erat.

source: She knew they focused on studying mysticism and Beyonder alchemy, opposing another knowledge-seeking secret organization, the Moses Ascetic Order.
target: Sciebat eos studere mystica et alchimia Beyonder, oppositos alteri organisationi secretæ quaesitae scientiae, Ordo Asceticus Moyses.

source: They were primarily active in the Intis region, the south-central zone, and the sea.
target: Praecipue in regione Intis, in zona meridionali centrali, atque in mari actuabant.

source: “It’s only natural for the Emperor’s belongings to be with his eldest daughter,” Lumian remarked, feeling somewhat pleased for Emperor Roselle.
target: “Naturale est ut bona Imperatoris cum filia eius primogenita sint,” Lumian remarkavit, paulo pro Imperatore Roselle laetus.

source: Franca asked Jebus excitedly, “Are you planning to confront Bernadette?”
target: Franca, Jebum excitata, rogavit: “Num Bernadettam oppugnare intendis?”

source: Jebus slowly shook his head.
target: Jebus caput leniter nutavit.

source: “We don’t have the necessary strength yet.
target: Non adhuc vim necessariam habemus.

source: That’s one of the reasons we collaborate with the Mirror People.
target: Hoc est una ex causis cur cum Hominibus Specularibus conlaboramus.

source: “Only by embracing and pleasing the truth can the Overseers obtain more boons to resist Bernadette and her subordinates.”
target: Solum veritatem amplectendo et placendo, Praefecti plura beneficia obtinere possunt ad resistendum Bernadettae et subditis eius.

source: Controlling the government and embracing the truth to varying degrees is a boon-seeking ritual?
target: Regere imperium et veritatem in variis gradibus amplecti, num talis ritus quaerendi beneficiorum est?

source: Yes, Jebus himself mentioned that this is a ritual to please the truth… Their boon‐receiving ritual differs from that of other evil god cults.
target: Ita, ipse Jebus dixit hoc esse ritum ad veritatem placandam… Ritus eorum ad beneficia accipienda differt ab aliis cultibus deorum malignorum.

source: Rather than primarily focusing on blood sacrifices, it emphasizes the influence, utilization, and transformation of order… Lumian summarized a key characteristic of the School of Truth based on Jebus’s words.
target: Potius quam sanguineis sacrificiis praesertim incumbere, extollit vim, usum atque transformationem ordinis… Lumian summatim enuntiavit proprietatem claram Scholae Veritatis ex verbis Jebus.

source: After a moment of contemplation, he asked, “Overseer is both a position and a name? What’s the Sequence equivalent in the potion pathway?”
target: Post momentum meditationis, interrogavit: “Praefectus est et officium et nomen? Quid est aequipollens Sequenciae in via potionis?”

source: “Sequence 4, having just attained godhood,” Jebus replied concisely.
target: “Sequencia 4, modo deitatem adeptus,” respondit Jebus concisē.

source: It was unclear whether he was reluctant to disclose such matters or if he simply didn’t know much.
target: Incertum erat utrum haec detegere velle recuserit an simpliciter parum sciret.

source: Lumian continued, “We’ve already grasped your school’s philosophy and objectives.
target: Lumian continuavit: “Iam intelleximus philosophiam et metas scholae tuae.

source: What’s the purpose of the Mirror People?
target: Quid est propositum Hominum Specularium?

source: Jebus pondered for a moment before responding, “They also want to break the seal of the ancient underground city.
target: Jebus paulisper meditatus est antequam respondit: “Volunt etiam sigillum urbis subterraneae antiquae frangere.

source: Only by breaking the seal can they enter the depths of the special mirror world where they originally resided and find something of great importance, but it has nothing to do with us.
target: Non nisi sigillum frangendo possunt inire in profundum specialis mundi specularis, in quo initio habitabant, et aliquid magni momenti invenire, sed ad nos nihil attinet.

source: They’ve been allowing more Mirror People to sneak out and replace the originals.
target: Sinunt plures Hominibus Specularibus clandestine evadere et originales substituere.

source: I’m not sure if they have any other motives.
target: Nescio an alias causas habeant.

source: “Apart from Moran Avigny, which other Mirror People do you know?” Franca didn’t conceal her desire to know the answer.
target: “Praeter Moran Avigny, quos alios Hominos Speculares nosti?” Franca desiderium scire responsum non celavit.

source: Jebus shook his head.
target: Jebus caput iterum nutavit.

source: “Ever since we reached a collaborative agreement with Moran Avigny, he’s had the other Mirror People change their positions and identities.
target: Ex quo cum Moran Avigny pactum fecimus, ille reliquos Hominibus Specularibus suas positiones et identitates mutare fecit.

source: He’s the only one who can contact them.
target: Ille solus est qui eos contingere potest.

source: “How did you discover that Moran Avigny is a Mirror Person?” Lumian sought additional clues.
target: “Quomodo detexisti Moran Avigny esse Hominum Specularium?” Lumian quaestiones additas quaerebat.

source: Jebus chuckled.
target: Jebus subridit.

source: “Our School of Truth was founded with some members of the Tamara family as its core.
target: Schola Veritatis nostra condita est cum quibusdam membris familiae Tamara, nucleum eius constituentes.

source: Several of them had long suspected that something was off with Moran Avigny and other clansmen.
target: Plurimi eorum diu suspicaverunt aliquid esse inordinatum de Moran Avigny et aliis membris clanii.

source: After receiving the truth’s revelation, they confirmed this suspicion.
target: Postquam revelationem veritatis acceperunt, hanc suspicionem confirmaverunt.

source: “Which pathway does Moran Avigny’s original body belong to?” Lumian frowned.
target: “Ad quam viam pertinet corpus originale Moran Avigny?” Lumian frontem contraxit.

source: Jebus didn’t conceal anything for Moran Avigny’s sake.
target: Jebus nihil pro Moran Avigny celavit.

source: “The Judgment pathway. Not only does he possess the power of the Judgment pathway, but he can also wield mirror-related powers.”
target: “Via Iudicii. Non solum vim viae Iudicii possidet, sed etiam potentias speculis conexas exercere potest.”

source: “Are there any members of the Tamara family’s Judgment lineage who don’t follow the truth and aren’t replaced by Mirror People?” Lumian inquired further.
target: “Num sunt membra stirpis Iudicii familiae Tamara, quae veritati non adhaereant nec ab Hominibus Specularibus substituantur?” Lumian ulterius interrogavit.

source: “Yes, they’ve cut ties with our School of Truth and have been trying to deal with us,” Jebus replied truthfully.
target: “Ita, víncula cum Schola Veritatis nostra secserunt et conantur nobiscum agere,” respondit Jebus sincere.

source: Wh— The Tamara family first split into two branches, Judgment and Apprentice.
target: Hem— Familia Tamara primum in duas partes divisit: Iudicii et Discipulorum.

source: Then, the Judgment branch splintered into three parts: those who believe in the truth, those replaced by the Mirror People, and those who adhered to their original traditions…
target: Deinde ramus Iudicii in tres partes divisus est: illi qui veritati credunt, illi qui ab Hominibus Specularibus substituti sunt, et illi qui traditionibus originariis adhaerebant…

source: However, the ones with the connection between the Apprentice branch of the Tamara family and the Demoness Sect are more likely to be replaced by the Mirror People.
target: Attamen, illi qui inter ramum Discipulorum familiae Tamara et Sectam Demonissae coniuncti sunt, verisimiliter ab Hominibus Specularibus substituti erunt.

source: Has that branch also fractured?
target: Etiamne ille ramus scissus est?

source: Why is the Tamara family constantly splintering…
target: Cur familia Tamara constanter in partes dividitur…?

source: Even if the Tamara family doesn’t fracture, there’s still the risk of being replaced by the Mirror People?
target: Etiamsi familia Tamara non scindatur, tamen periculum existit ut ab Hominibus Specularibus substituatur?

source: Could this stem from some unresolved mysteries of the Fourth Epoc/i?
target: Potestne hoc ex non resolutis mysteriosis Quartae Epochae provenire?

source: Lumian analyzed and speculated based on the available information.
target: Lumian informationibus praesto datum analysavit atque speculatus est.

source: “What’s Moran Avigny’s approximate Sequence?” Jenna asked, noticing Lumian’s silence.
target: “Quae est Sequencia approximata Moran Avigny?” Jenna interrogavit, silentium Lumiani animadvertens.

source: “Sequence 5,” Jebus answered Jenna’s question with a smile.
target: “Sequencia 5,” respondit Jebus quaestioni Jennae cum risu.

source: Sequence 5 Disciplinary Paladin… Franca, under the guidance of Madam Judgment, a Major Arcana card holder, was well-versed in the Arbiter pathway.
target: Sequencia 5: Paladinus Disciplinarius… Franca, sub ductu Dominae Iudicii, possessoris chartae Maior Arcana, in via Arbiter perita erat.

source: Sequence 9 was Arbiter, Sequence 8 was Sheriff, Sequence 7 was Interrogator, and Sequence 6 was Judge.
target: Sequencia 9 erat Arbiter, Sequencia 8 erat Praefectus, Sequencia 7 erat Interrogator, et Sequencia 6 erat Iudex.

source: Disciplinary Paladin with mirror magic and mirror world-related abilities… Lumian looked at Jebus and asked with a smile,
target: Paladinus Disciplinarius, qui magiam specularum atque facultates ad mundum specularum pertinentis habet… Lumian ad Jebum aspexit et, risu, rogavit:

source: “You’re not a Mirror Person or a Demoness.
target: “Non es Hominus Specularis neque Demonissa.

source: Why can you freely enter and exit the mirror world without being affected by the dangers there?
target: Cur libere in mundum specularum ingredi et exire potes, sine periculis ibi affici?

source: Jebus pointed at the glass cufflink on his sleeve.
target: Jebus ad fibulam vitream in manica sua monstravit.

source: “This is an item given to us by Moran Avigny.
target: “Hoc est obiectum nobis a Moran Avigny datum.

source: It allows us to enter and exit the mirror world and use the connections between mirrors to traverse without being absorbed into other mirrors.
target: Id nobis sinit in mundum specularum ingredi et exire, atque nexus inter specula ad iter peragenda uti, sine in alia specula absorbendi.

source: “I can still use it five times.”
target: “Eam adhuc quinque vicibus uti possum.”

source: Very good.
target: Valde bene.

source: It will be ours in the future… Yes, lets call them Mirror Cufflink..
target: In futuro nostra erunt… Ita, eas “Fibula Specularis” appellabimus.

source: At that moment, Franca had already thought of a name for the cufflink.
target: Illo momento, Franca iam nomen pro fibula cogitaverat.

source: Lumian nodded and replied, “If your abilities correspond to a potion pathway, what would Sequence 9 be called?”
target: Lumian annuit et respondit: “Si facultates tuae ad viam potionis respondent, quid Sequencia 9 appellabitur?”

source: Given the looming potential conflict with the School of Truth, Lumian didn’t let the opportunity to understand the other party’s Beyonder powers slip away.
target: Ob imminentem conflictum cum Schola Veritatis, Lumian occasionem ad intellegendas potentias Beyonder alterius partis non amittere permisit.

source: A proud smile graced Jebus’s face.
target: Superbus risus vultum Jebus ornabat.

source: “It’s Broker.
target: “Broker est.

source: We are the gray between white and black, the fog between light and darkness.
target: Nos sumus cinerei inter album et nigrum, nebula inter lucem et tenebras.

source: We are the bridge between order and shadows!”
target: Nos sumus pons inter ordinem et umbras!

source: “Could you say something more comprehensible…” Franca muttered under her breath.
target: “Potesne aliquid clarius dicere…” Franca submurmuravit.

source: Lumian smiled and asked without hesitation, “What abilities does Broker possess?”
target: Lumian subridens sine mora interrogavit: “Quae facultates Broker possidet?”
